releaseNotes: Urgent Stable Intune enrollment recovery. Service 0.2.5.27 refreshes the active Entra user's PRT, waits for newly enabled MDM discovery to propagate, and invokes the supported Windows system-context enrollment fallback only when Windows denies the interactive call. Existing tenant guards, repeat-enrollment prevention, persisted retry state, MDM evidence verification, and Sense/MDE reporting remain in place. Tray remains 1.0.0.19.
